# R7 · release-18.4.0-w2-owed · owed-retest set (8 items) · subject 5fb79bc0

## 1. Environment

- Tree `/home/user/objectstack` at `5fb79bc010cc9ab749dc29bfe44c83ef19f3dd11` (`5fb79bc0`); console built by the dispatcher from `ui/` (bundle carries the #32107 fix: `twoFactorRedirect` in `packages/console/dist/assets/index-BlQDOpR0.js`). No build, install or tree edit by R7.
- Every showcase boot: `OS_PORT=P OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT=/tmp/qa184/R7/uploads-P setsid pnpm -C …/examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin --no-compile --no-watch -p P -d file:/tmp/qa184/R7/‹item›.db`.
- Ports and DBs:
  - 41640: meta-save
  - 41641: error-envelope
  - 41642: trigger-status
  - 41643: flow-error-handling
  - 41644: notify (booted twice)
  - 41645: attachments
  - 41646: email. Booted twice: the second boot is the redeploy-survival leg.
  - 41647: plugin-email `startFakeSmtp` under tsx, listen port pinned to 41647
  - 41648: auth with `OS_AUTH_PHONE_NUMBER_ENABLED=true OS_AUTH_TWO_FACTOR=true`
  - 41649: auth stock (methods off)
  - 41650: local slow HTTP server for RESUME_IN_PROGRESS
  - 41651: auth with `NODE_ENV=production OS_AUTH_PHONE_NUMBER_ENABLED=true`
  - 41652: scratch copy of app-todo, `requires + 'auth'`, `--preset minimal` (no MessagingServicePlugin)
  - 41653: writable scratch copy of app-showcase, `--no-compile --no-restart`
- Scratch copies live under `/tmp/qa184/R7/` (`todo-copy`, `showcase-copy`), with `node_modules` symlinked. Uploads stayed under `/tmp/qa184/R7/uploads-41645` (checked: nothing outside it; `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/installed-packages` absent). `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/data/showcase_external.db` exists in the tree. Every tree boot creates it, and it is harmless (RUNNER fact).
- Personas:
  - seeded admin `admin@objectos.ai`
  - seeded Mei `phone.demo@example.com`
  - members minted by `admin/create-user` and then `change-password`: `qa.assignee@`, `qa.third@`, `qa.mailmember@`, `qa.zhcn@`, `qa.zh@`, `qa.ja@` (all `@example.com`)
  - Identity was proven by `get-session` before each persona's cells.
- Time: 23:14Z to 23:52Z (about 38 min wall). The container restarted at about 23:25Z; meta-save and error-envelope evidence had already been captured, and the three automation boots were re-done. Split: about 12 min environment (boots, restart recovery, sink, scratch copies), about 26 min testing including probes. All servers, the sink and the slow server were stopped by their own process group at the end. No listener remains on 41640–41659.
- Sequential run (no sub-runners).

## 2. Per-item verdicts
